svg.text: Every box is a real file / folder. Solid arrow = calls / uses. Dashed grey = response. Dotted with hollow head = implements. Red dashed = exception path.
CLIENT — client/src (React 19 · TypeScript · Vite · react-leaflet 5 / Leaflet 1.9)
DTOs + view models, shared by all
App.tsx — root component: owns the interaction state and wires map ↔ panels
delete* with window.confirm · keys Esc, Backspace/Ctrl+Z · beforeunload
derive rows = buildMapDataRows(polygons.saved, objects.saved) ← saved only
FocusController flyTo on Map Data row click
InitialFit fitBounds once after first load
icons.ts Leaflet pin + Jeep SVG divIcon, cached
drafts: dashed polygons, faded icons, draggable markers
Add · Save · Delete selected · Delete all
table Object / Lat / Lon, row click = select
hooks/useEditableCollection.ts — generic, one instance per resource (polygons, objects)
state saved (server truth) · drafts (browser only) · selectedId · busy · error · loaded
ops addDraft · updateDraft · reload (GET on mount, AbortController)
saveDrafts → POST drafts, replace saved with the returned full list
deleteSelected (draft: local only | saved: DELETE + reload) · deleteAll
items = [...saved, ...drafts] → map; saved → table; errors → describeError(e, draftNames)
HTTP · REST · JSON · GeoJSON positions [longitude, latitude] · errors: application/problem+json (RFC 7807)
Program.cs — host, DI and middleware pipeline (order matters)
GetAll / GetById / Delete / DeleteAll just delegate to the repository
Point: type == "Point", [lon, lat], finite, lon ±180, lat ±90
1 exactly one ring, ≤ 1000 vertices, valid positions
4 CW → CCW via Reverse(1, n-1) (keeps 1st vertex)
Data/ — persistence · MongoConventions: camelCase, enums as strings
Id, Name, Symbol, Location: GeoJsonPoint, CreatedAt
polygons { _id, name, geometry: { type: "Polygon", coordinates: [[[lng,lat]…]] }, createdAt }
mapObjects { _id, name, symbol: "Jeep", location: { type: "Point", coordinates: [lng,lat] }, createdAt }
both geometry fields have a 2dsphere index → MongoDB itself rejects invalid GeoJSON (error 16755)
GeometryValidatorTests — closing, CCW, dedupe, bow-tie, ranges, holes
ServiceTests — batch all-or-nothing, names, full list
client (Vitest, 11 tests): geo.test.ts — axis order, normalizeLatLng, polygonProblem, nextName, rows
